slides.title: One drawing, many copies
slides.text: You send one drawing to a friend. It passes through many hands on the way, and every stop could keep a copy, like stamps in Pim's sorting book. A copy sent out cannot be called back.
slides.alt: Many Roads: the town map offers more than one road between the same houses, and a closed road is not the end.

focus.cue: One drawing sets off across the roads
Every stop could keep a copy along the way

slides.title: Copies kept safe
slides.text: The cloud is someone else's very big post office that keeps copies safe for you. A backup there saves your photos when a tablet breaks.
slides.alt: A Good Spare Copy: the sorting round that tells a real backup, kept somewhere else, from a copy that is not.

focus.cue: Sorting spare copies: which way keeps them safe?
A copy in another place survives a broken tablet

slides.title: Passed on without you
slides.text: A copy you send to a friend can be forwarded to others without you knowing. Once a copy travels on, you cannot call it back.
slides.alt: The second of four packets is on its way across the diamond map, two hops done and two to go.

focus.cue: Packet 2 waits at Hill Office, two hops done
Packet 2 of 4: its number travels with it

slides.title: The noticeboard test
slides.text: Before Pim sends a copy, Pim asks one question. Would this look fine pinned on the town noticeboard?
steps: a sunny drawing of a dog: fine to send
a private secret about a friend: keep it
not sure: ask a trusted adult first
slides.alt: Would you rather share a drawing so everyone can see it, or show it only to your family?

focus.cue: Share a drawing so everyone can see it
Or show it only to your family

slides.title: The Magpie's nest
slides.text: Pim warns that the Magpie keeps a copy of every shiny secret it finds. In its nest, those copies stay pinned up, forever.
slides.alt: A trick card from someone you do not know: it fishes for the street a player lives on.

focus.cue: A stranger's card, fishing for a shiny secret
It asks where you live: a fact to keep private

words.means: one more version of the same photo or message
someone else's big computers that keep copies safe for you
a spare copy kept safe in case the first one is lost
to pass a copy on to someone else

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Play Many Roads in Packet Post for all 4 levels, tracing every message's journey. Name one thing you would never send, because copies cannot come back.
slides.alt: Many Roads: the town map offers more than one road between the same houses, and a closed road is not the end.

focus.cue: Play Many Roads: trace every copy's journey
